verdict.rationale: The official bw CLI's documented `bw serve` mode exposes the whole vault as a local RESTful Vault Management API that an agent can query for TOTP codes and items. The CLI installs and runs per the runtime probe, and personal API keys support automated, non-interactive auth. An official MCP server also completed a live stdio handshake, and a community report confirms the CLI returns passwords and current TOTP codes programmatically. Missing for 10: a first-party docs excerpt detailing the `bw serve` endpoints and auth model (it is described only via probe), and a hands-on run actually querying the local `bw serve` API for a TOTP code.
